summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K reporting several post-IPO events: conversion of ~103M Series Preferred shares into Class A and Class B common stock (exempt under Section 3(a)(9)), adoption of an amended 2024 equity incentive plan with ~300.9M shares available, and a second amended employee stock purchase plan. No special-situation event—these are routine corporate actions following an IPO. No price, premium, or board recommendation details provided. What to watch: ongoing share trading and equity plan utilization. Class A common trades on Nasdaq under SPCX.
